subject: Add legend on tip labels when using geom_tipppoint

messages.author: 0a606ccf0fbbf52f
messages.subject: Add legend on tip labels when using geom_tipppoint
parts:
Hello,

I have been trying to add a legend on the 5 different colours I used to mark the tips of a phylogenetic tree.

I could not find any solution, although 'geom_tippoint' has an option 'show.legend = TRUE', but it does not seem to work in my case, unless I'm making some mistake in the script.

This is the command I used:

ggtree(new.tree,layout=phylo_method)+
geom_nodepoint(size=c(NA,size_node),colour=c(NA,col_node),pch=8,na.rm =TRUE)+
geom_tiplab(align=FALSE, linetype='dashed', linesize=.3,size=2)+
geom_tippoint(color=raxml_col, size=2, show.legend = TRUE)

Any suggestion?

Thank you in advance

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Add legend on tip labels when using geom_tipppoint
parts: if you pass the color parameter directly, there will be no legend.
geom_tippoint(color=raxml_col, size=2, show.legend = TRUE)

and there may be another issue that your raxml_col may not match the tips in the order you want.

For your reference, http://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/chapter7.html#attach-operator
